'''Kombat''' is a 1on1 tournament starting '''February 26th''', with split divisions depending on amount of signups, where top players from each group proceed to a short single elimination playoffs.
The tournament will have a regular scheduling system per round, 1 match per week.

== Format ==
* Start date: Monday February 26
** Estimated finishing time: April 20
* Group stage into playoffs
* Single elimination playoffs
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO5|Best of 5}}
** Map order: ''tron, loser pick, loser pick, loser pick, play''

== Rules ==
* Map order: '' '''tron''', loser '''pick''', loser '''pick''', loser '''pick''', '''play''' ''
* Ping rules
** Keep ping difference even, more than 14 ping difference per player can be considered uneven. If server cannot be found where ping difference is even enough, then use cl_delay_packet to even it out until 14 ping difference. 
** This is a EU tournament. European players should never require to play on higher than 52 ping, if someone has 52+ then find a server where opponent has minimum 38 ping. NA players (100+ ping) can expect to play on a server where opponent is not on ping 14, but have around 38-52 (usually ireland/london servers)
* Client: ezQuake 3.2.x or 3.6.x
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
* Scheduling: 
** Deadline to complete group matches is 3 weeks from start. 
** It is not required to follow given match order in group schedule - though it is required to schedule minimum 1 match per week. Walkovers are given after group stage deadlines.
** Playoffs: 1 match required per week.
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>, or message {{Player|alice|flag=se}}
